role: The 17-rule default trigger catalogue for WorkoutTriggerEngine, as factory functions each pairing a condition predicate and message builder, with small closure-captured state classes for rules that need per-workout memory (α1 VT2 streak, HR-spike streak, threshold cooldowns, split index, readiness/race-pace/periodic/load once-flags).
state: closure-captured per-rule instances of Alpha1VT2State, HRSpikeState, ThresholdCooldownState, SplitMarkerState, ReadinessOpeningState, RacePaceState, CoachUpdateState, RecentLoadState (one per engine, created when defaultRules() runs)

flags.text: Only user.threshold.breach is .spoken. The other 16 rules are .silent (13) or .haptic (3: hr.spikeNoPace, equipment.strapDown, cadence.consistencyDrop) and WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch drops both tiers, so their messages, including the long 'Speak ONE short sentence…' LLM prompts for split, decoupling, readiness, race pace, periodic and load rules, are never spoken or sent to any model. The prompt text implies an AI path that does not exist.

Conditions mutate closure state (set fired flags, advance split index, stamp lastSpokenAt in the message builder). Correctness depends on evaluate() calling condition then message exactly once per firing; any second evaluation (for example a dry-run or preview) would consume the once-per-workout or cooldown state.

units.does: Returns the four effort rules in order: alpha1.belowAeT, alpha1.aboveVT2, hr.driftHigh, hr.spikeNoPace.
Returns true when α1 fit R² is unknown or ≥ 0.85; false when the last DFA fit is poor.

branches.effect: nil: returns true (gate passes when quality unknown); else returns r2 >= 0.85

units.does: Builds rule alpha1.belowAeT: tier .silent: event only lands in the engine's unread in-memory history (WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch ignores .silent), routine, 20 min cooldown, condition alpha1BelowAeTCondition, message alpha1BelowAeTMessage.

flags.text: Comment says 'α1 crosses below aerobic threshold → call it out once', but the condition is a level test (0.60 <= α1 < 0.75) with a 20 min cooldown, so it re-fires every 20 min while α1 stays in the band; there is no crossing detection.

units.does: True when the fit-quality gate passes and α1 is in [0.60, 0.75).
Localized line quoting α1 to 2 dp and calling it the aerobic edge, offering to back off or hold for tempo.

branches.effect: would print 0.75; unreachable because the condition requires α1 non-nil on the same ctx

units.does: Builds rule alpha1.aboveVT2 (.silent, routine, 15 min cooldown) with a fresh Alpha1VT2State captured by its condition, message and reset closures.
Requires the fit gate and a known α1; on each NEW α1 value increments consecutiveBelow when α1 < 0.50 else resets it; fires when the streak is ≥ 2 and current α1 < 0.50.

branches.effect: false: returns false without touching the streak
true: records it and updates streak; false: streak unchanged (same 20 s recompute seen again)

flags.text: Streak compares exact Double equality to detect a 'new' reading; two consecutive recomputes that happen to produce the identical value are counted as one, and the streak is frozen during the 15 min cooldown (see engine evaluate).

Comment says the rule targets 'a session the user said was easy', but the condition never reads targetZone or any intent field; it fires on any α1 < 0.50 streak regardless of intended intensity. Also the streak is not reset when the fit gate fails or α1 is nil (lines 114-115), so two sub-0.50 readings separated by rejected windows still count as 'consecutive'.

units.does: Localized line quoting α1 and saying the user is above anaerobic threshold, easing up optional.

branches.effect: prints 0.00; unreachable since the condition requires α1

units.does: Resets the α1 VT2 streak to 0 and lastSeen to -1.
Builds rule hr.driftHigh (.silent, routine, 20 min cooldown) with hrDriftHighCondition / hrDriftHighMessage.
Fires when live HR drift > 5% after 30 min, grade is known and within ±2%, and recent HR slope is known and non-negative.

branches.effect: true: false (HR falling); else returns true

flags.text: Comment says the minimum elapsed floor was bumped beyond 30 min ('Doubling the back-quartile sample requirement'), but the code still gates on elapsedSeconds > 30*60.

units.does: Localized drift line with drift %, plus current HR and signed grade when known (four phrasing variants).

branches.effect: prints 0; unreachable because condition requires drift
HR + grade + drift sentence (the only reachable case when HR is known, since condition requires grade)
HR + drift; unreachable: condition requires grade
grade + drift; used when no HR sample yet
drift only; unreachable: condition requires grade

units.does: Builds rule hr.spikeNoPace (.haptic → no-op in coach, routine, 10 min cooldown) with a fresh HRSpikeState.

Requires known HR with positive max HR (else resets streak), a GPS sport, current pace, positive most-recent split pace and a known grade within ±2%; on each new HR value counts consecutive samples where HR > 85% max and current pace is >5% slower than the last split; fires at streak ≥ 2.

branches.effect: false: resets consecutiveAbove to 0 and returns false
false: returns false (indoor sports never fire)

branches.cond: current pace, positive last split pace and grade within ±2% all known
branches.effect: false: returns false without resetting the streak
true: updates streak; false: streak unchanged — an unchanged HR value on consecutive samples counts once

branches.cond: meetsCriteria (HR > 85% max AND pace > last split × 1.05)
branches.effect: true: increment streak; false: reset to 0

flags.text: 'New sample' is detected as HR value != lastSeenHR, so a sustained spike at a constant integer HR (e.g. 165,165,165) advances the streak only once and never reaches 2; and the early returns at 257-261 (non-GPS sport, pace/grade unknown or grade > 2%) do not reset consecutiveAbove, so samples separated by such gaps still count as consecutive, contrary to the 'two CONSECUTIVE NEW HR samples' comment.

units.does: Localized 'pace didn't pick up' line with HR and signed grade when known (four variants).

branches.effect: HR + grade sentence — the only reachable case (condition requires HR and grade)

units.does: Resets the HR-spike streak to 0 and lastSeenHR to -1.
Returns terrain.climbAhead, zone.drifted.high, zone.drifted.low, route.climbAhead in order.
Builds rule terrain.climbAhead (.silent, 10 min cooldown): fires when an upcoming climb has grade ≥ 3% and starts ≥ 100 m ahead.

flags.text: Comment says 'sustained climb (>3% over ~200 m)' but the condition tests climb.distanceMeters, which is how far AHEAD the climb starts (UpcomingClimb doc), not its length; lengthMeters is ignored.
terrain.climbAhead and route.climbAhead both fire on the same ctx.upcomingClimb with overlapping windows; both are .silent.

units.does: Localized climb-ahead line with grade and distance, prefixed with HR when known.

branches.effect: 0 m; unreachable since condition requires a climb
nil: sentence without HR; else sentence starting 'HR's at <hr>'

units.does: Builds rule zone.drifted.high (.silent, 150 s cooldown) with zoneDriftedHighCondition / zoneDriftedHighMessage.
Fires when a target zone and HR are known, HR fraction of max exceeds the target zone's top (N×0.10+0.50) by > 3 points after 60 s, and grade is known and ≤ +2%.

branches.effect: false: false; for target zone 5 the bound is 1.03 × max HR so it practically never fires
true: false (climbing); else true (descents not suppressed)

units.does: Localized 'drifted above Zone N' line with HR.

branches.effect: Zone 0; unreachable since condition requires target

units.does: Builds rule zone.drifted.low (.silent, 150 s cooldown): fires when target zone > 1, HR fraction is > 3 points below the bottom of the target zone, after 180 s; message says HR is easier than Zone N.

branches.cond: targetZone known and > 1, heartRate known, userMaxHR > 0
branches.effect: false: returns false (zone 1 target never fires low); true: compares pct to lowerBound - 0.03 and elapsed > 180

units.does: Builds rule route.climbAhead (.silent, 8 min cooldown) with routeClimbAheadCondition / routeClimbAheadMessage.
True when an upcoming climb starts between 0 and 500 m ahead (exclusive).
Builds the route-climb sentence: distance in yards (imperial) or metres, grade percent, optional climb length, and 'First of N' when routeTopology lists more than one climb ahead.
Chooses one of four localized sentences by whether a length label exists and whether more than one climb is ahead.
Spoken climb length: nil when length ≤ 0; imperial gives feet under 0.1 mi else miles (1 dp); metric gives metres under 0.1 km else km (1 dp).
Returns equipment.strapDown, user.threshold.breach, split.markerCompleted, cadence.consistencyDrop in order.
Builds rule equipment.strapDown (.haptic, urgent, 60 s cooldown): fires whenever ctx.strapConnected is false; message says the strap went quiet and HR switches to the Watch.

flags.text: Condition is just `!strapConnected`, which is also true for every workout recorded without a Polar strap, so the rule 'fires' every 60 s for Watch-only sessions with a 'Strap just went quiet' message. Because the tier is .haptic (no-op) nothing is heard, but it fills the 200-event history and the rule cannot represent a real drop.

units.does: Builds the only .spoken rule, user.threshold.breach (urgent, 30 s floor cooldown), with a ThresholdCooldownState: condition is 'any due threshold', message picks the longest-breached one, reset clears lastSpokenAt.
Filters active thresholds to those breached > 0 s and ≥ their debounce whose own cooldown (on the workout clock) has expired since last spoken, sorted by longest breach first.

branches.effect: none: due; else due only if elapsed - last >= cooldownSec

units.does: Takes the first due threshold, stamps its lastSpokenAt with the current workout second, and returns its user cue if non-empty or the threshold's default cue using the observed metric value; if none due returns 'Threshold breached.'

branches.effect: none: returns generic 'Threshold breached.' (only if state changed between condition and message, which does not happen in evaluate)
returns user cue verbatim; else defaultCue(currentValue:)

flags.text: The threshold's own cooldown is started in the message builder, which runs whether or not the event is spoken: when the coach is muted or coachAlertsEnabled is off, the cue is consumed silently and the next spoken cue waits a full cooldownSec after unmute.

units.does: Returns the live reading for the threshold's metric (HR, power, pace, α1, cadence, 0 when unsampled) or the threshold's own value for other metrics.

branches.cond: default (zone, %FTP, distance, elapsed, elevation, grade, naturalLanguage)

units.does: Builds rule split.markerCompleted (.silent, cooldown 0) with a SplitMarkerState; reset sets lastSplitFiredAt = 0.
Computes the current whole-mile (imperial) or whole-km index; fires and records it when it exceeds the last fired index and at least 60 s have elapsed.

branches.effect: false: false (index not consumed, fires on a later tick); true: records index, returns true

units.does: Returns an English LLM prompt ('You just finished mile/kilometer N…') asking for one sentence comparing the split with historical baselines.
Builds rule cadence.consistencyDrop (.haptic → no-op, 8 min cooldown): fires when cadence drift < -5 spm after 15 min; message reports the drop.
Returns aerobic.decouplingMaterial, readiness.openingRecommendation, race.paceMode.detected, coach.periodicUpdate, training.recentLoadAboveUsualRange in order.
Builds rule aerobic.decouplingMaterial (.silent, 15 min cooldown): fires when decoupling > 5% after 25 min unless grade is known and > +2%; message is an English LLM prompt.

branches.effect: true: false; nil grade passes (fail-open, unlike hr.driftHigh and zone.drifted.high)

flags.text: Comment says decoupling is 'Spoken so the AI can frame it', but the rule tier is .silent, which WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch drops; its LLM prompt message is never spoken or sent to a model.

units.does: Builds rule readiness.openingRecommendation (.silent, cooldown 0) with a ReadinessOpeningState; message is an English LLM prompt for a push/back-off framing; reset clears fired.
Fires once per workout between 180 s and 600 s when any of recovery score, TSB or days-until-fresh is known; sets fired.

branches.effect: false: false (window missed means never fires)
false: false; true: sets fired, returns true

units.does: Builds rule race.paceMode.detected (.silent, cooldown 0) with a RacePaceState; message is an English LLM prompt about holding 5K race pace.

Once per workout after 5 min, with current pace and a 5K prediction known, accumulates wall-clock seconds while pace stays within ±3% of predicted 5K pace (resetting when it leaves the band); fires at 120 contiguous seconds.

branches.cond: not fired, elapsed >= 300, pace > 0 known, 5K prediction known

branches.effect: true: adds whole seconds since last tick; false: no accumulation this tick
false: false; true: sets fired, returns true

flags.text: Uses Date() wall clock instead of the `now` passed to WorkoutTriggerEngine.evaluate, so the rule cannot be driven deterministically and a gap between ticks (backgrounding) counts as time at race pace.

units.does: Zeros sustainedSec, sets lastTickAt to now, returns false.
Zeros sustainedSec, clears fired and lastTickAt.
Builds rule coach.periodicUpdate (.silent, cooldown 0) with a CoachUpdateState; reset clears lastFiredAt.

Reads current UserSettings each tick; when periodic updates are enabled, elapsed ≥ cadence (min 60 s), at least one cadence has passed since last fire (wall clock), and a live signal exists, stamps lastFiredAt and fires.

branches.cond: lastFiredAt set and less than cadence seconds ago

branches.effect: false: false; true: stamps and fires

flags.text: A rule condition reaches into the global AppDependencies.current settings singleton, so the 'pure evaluator' engine depends on app-wide state and cannot be evaluated with injected settings.

units.does: True when any of live HR drift, decoupling, reverse-split delta or cadence drift is present, or the user has at least one historical workout of this sport.

flags.text: Doc says the update requires 'at least one live trend metric', but historicalSportSampleCount > 0 also passes, so a user with any history satisfies it from the first cadence window without any live metric.

units.does: English LLM prompt stating minutes elapsed and asking for one sentence about the single most relevant signal, or silence.
Builds rule training.recentLoadAboveUsualRange (.silent, cooldown 0) with a RecentLoadState; reset clears fired.
Fires once per workout when today's ATL/CTL ratio is ≥ 1.4 (CTL > 0); sets fired. No elapsed-time gate, so it fires on the first tick.

branches.cond: todayATL and todayCTL known with CTL > 0

branches.effect: false: false; true: sets fired, returns true

units.does: English LLM prompt describing recent load as above (≥1.4) or noticeably above (≥1.5) the usual range without naming ACWR.
